title: Lazy Iterator Pipeline - Strict Evaluation Order & StopIteration Isolation
failure_mode: LLMs implement lazy pipelines that eagerly materialize intermediate collections, violate single-pass evaluation constraints, or allow StopIteration to escape generator frames (PEP 479)
invariant_guarantee: Zero intermediate list materializations (O(1) memory), exactly-once element production across chained transformations, and strict PEP-479 StopIteration-to-RuntimeError conversion
